page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top centre; page number at top left; catchword at the right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: oculos, vt commemorent sanctæ Scripturæ testimonia, nec intueantur in factis Prophetarum quemadmodum intelligenda sint verba Prophetarum. lib. 3.
Eos teneamus interfectores Prophetarum, quos contradictores inuenerimus linguis Prophetarum. lib. 2. contra litteras Petiliani, cap. 14;

Noli dicere, Absit, absit à nostra conscientia, vt ad nostram fidem aliquem compellamus. Facitis enim vbi potestis, vbi autem non facitis, non potestis, siue legum, siue inuidiæ timore, siue resistentium multitudine. lib. 2. cap. 15.

Ita miseris plebibus vos venditatis, vt sine peccato vos esse credant, & peccata sua vestris orationibus purganda committant. Magni homines vos, excelsi, cœlestes, diuini, non iam homines sed Angeli, qui pro plebibus oratis, & pro vobis plebes orare non vultis. lib. 2. cap. 105.

Qui disputat, verum discernit à falso. Quod qui [velut Iesuitæ] non possunt, & tamen Dialectici videri volunt, per insidiosas interrogationes captant incautorum assensiones, vt ex eorum responsionibus concludant, unde illos vel in aperta falsitate deceptos rideant, vel occultam falsitatem deceptis persuadeant, quam plerumque etiam ipsi existimant veritatem. (contra Fres[?]conium grammatic. lib. primo, cap. 15.)

page.notes: Page number "126" and running head read from the scan. Doubtful: "Fresconium" in the last paragraph (the letter after "Fre" is hard to make out, so it is marked [?]). The reference numbers "14;" and "15." are read as printed, and the "3." after "lib." is a yogh-like figure, read as 3. The catchword "Rectè" is at the right below the last line.
